title: ι(X') is a quasi-fundamental domain of the induced space
body_html:
$\iota(X')$ is a quasi-fundamental domain of $G \times^P X'$

Fix the induction data $(G', P)$ satisfying (P0)–(P2) and the induced space $X = G \times^P X'$ ([[node:equivariant_sheaves.induction_GxP_X]]). Two different objects appear together in this node and must be kept distinct:

  • $X'$ — the base of the induction, a $G'$-space in its own right (its own type in Lean: {X' : Type*} [MulAction G X'], though the action seen from inside the induction is restricted to $G' \le G$).
  • $S := \iota(X') \subseteq X$ — a face-closed subcomplex of $X$, formalised as Subcomplex.ofIota d : Subcomplex (InducedSpace d). This is the QFD.

The two are related by the poset bijection $\iota : X' \to S$ (whose injectivity is ι : X' → G ×^P X' is a cellular embedding (poset form) clause (1)) but they live in different types.

Proposition.

  1. $S := \iota(X')$ is a face-closed subcomplex of $X$.
  2. The pair $(G', S)$ makes $S$ a [[quasi-fundamental domain|node:equivariant_sheaves.quasi_fundamental_domain]] of the $G$-space $X$; equivalently, the natural map $$ G' \backslash [\![S]\!] \;\xrightarrow{\;\sim\;}\; G \backslash [\![X]\!] $$ is a bijection.
  3. Moreover $G' \le \Stab_G(S)$; the sharp subgroup $G'$ is generally strictly smaller than the setwise stabiliser of $S$ in $G$.
proof_html:
(1) Subcomplex. For face closure, take $q \preceq \iota E$ in $X$, with $E \in [\![X']\!]$. By clauses (4) and (6) of ι : X' → G ×^P X' is a cellular embedding (poset form), $q = g \cdot \iota F$ for some $g \in G$, $F \in [![X']!]$, and there exists $n \in G'$ with $n \cdot F \preceq E$ and $g^{-1} n \in P_E$. Then $g = n \cdot p^{-1}$ for some $p \in P_E$, so $q = n \cdot p^{-1} \cdot \iota F = n \cdot \iota F$ (using $P_E \subseteq \Fix_G(E)$ from Cell-stabiliser and fixator formulas on the induced space to see $p^{-1} \cdot \iota F = \iota F$ after face-closing to $E$), so $q = \iota(n \cdot F) \in S$ by $G'$-equivariance of $\iota$.

(2) QFD. Coverage is clause (4) of ι : X' → G ×^P X' is a cellular embedding (poset form): every cell of $X$ is a $G$-translate of some $\iota E \in S$.

For injectivity on $G$-orbits, apply clause (5) with $g_1 = 1$: if $g \cdot \iota E = \iota F$ (both in $S$) then there exists $n \in G'$ with $n \cdot E = F$ and $g n \in P_E \subseteq \Fix_G(E)$. Hence $\iota E$ and $\iota F$ are related by an element of $G'$ (through $n$), and we recover the orbit statement of the QFD definition.

(3) $G' \le \Stab_G(S)$. For $n \in G'$ and $E \in [\![X']\!]$, clause (3) of ι : X' → G ×^P X' is a cellular embedding (poset form) gives $n \cdot \iota E = \iota(n \cdot E) \in S$. The reverse inclusion $n^{-1} \cdot S \subseteq S$ is symmetric. Strictness: if $g \in \Stab_G(S)$ then $g \cdot \iota E = \iota F$ for some $F \in [![X']!]$, but $g$ need not lie in $G'$ — the residue is absorbed by $P_E$ (see (P4) in Recovering the induction data from a quasi-fundamental domain). $\square$

Downstream

Combined with the topological clauses of CW structure and QFD property on G ×^P X' (Hausdorffness, weak topology, regularity, characteristic maps — outside the abstract poset setting), this node closes the proof that $\iota : X' \hookrightarrow X$ is a QFD embedding of the induction base.

The QFD-with-sharp-$G'$ statement is the input to the reverse direction of the induction/QFD correspondence (Recovering the induction data from a quasi-fundamental domain).

Lean formalization

The image of $\iota$ as a face-closed subcomplex is

def Subcomplex.ofIota : SheafOnBuilding.Subcomplex (InducedSpace d) where
  carrier := Set.range (iota d)
  face_closed := ...

Note the type: Subcomplex (InducedSpace d) — this is a subcomplex of the induced $G$-space, not the induction base $X'$.

The auxiliary inclusion $G' \le \Stab_G(S)$ (statement (3)) is

theorem G'_le_subcomplexOfIota_stabilizer :
    d.G' ≤ (Subcomplex.ofIota d).stabilizer

The main QFD statement (2) is the class instance

instance isQuasiFundDomain_subcomplexOfIota :
    IsQuasiFundDomain d.G' (Subcomplex.ofIota d)

using the sharp subgroup d.G' (not (Subcomplex.ofIota d).stabilizer). The orbit_iff field is discharged using ι : X' → G ×^P X' is a cellular embedding (poset form) clause (5) and the stabiliser formula Cell-stabiliser and fixator formulas on the induced space to see that $g_1^{-1} g_2 n \in P_E$ implies $(g_1^{-1} g_2 n) \cdot E = E$ at the poset level (via P_le_stabilizer_iota).

lean_refs.signature:
def Subcomplex.ofIota : SheafOnBuilding.Subcomplex (InducedSpace d) where
  carrier := Set.range (iota d)
  face_closed' := by
    rintro q₁ q₂ h_le ⟨F, hF_eq⟩
    -- q₂ = iota F; h_le : q₁ ≤ iota F.  Need q₁ ∈ range iota.
    -- Pick rep (g, E) of q₁.  InductionLe (g, E) (1, F) gives n ∈ G' with
    -- n • E ≤ F and g⁻¹ * 1 * n ∈ P E.  Then (g, E) ~ (1, n • E):
    -- witness m = n, m • E = n • E (rfl), g⁻¹ * 1 * n ∈ P E.
    -- Hence q₁ = ⟦(g, E)⟧ = ⟦(1, n • E)⟧ = iota (n • E).
    revert h_le
    refine Quotient.inductionOn q₁ ?_
    rintro ⟨g, E⟩ h_le
    -- Rewrite q₂ in h_le using hF_eq:
    rw [← hF_eq] at h_le
    obtain ⟨n, hn_G, _hn_le, hn_P⟩ := h_le
    refine ⟨n • E, ?_⟩
    -- Goal: iota d (n • E) = ⟦(g, E)⟧.
    -- iota d (n • E) = ⟦(1, n • E)⟧; relate via Quotient.sound.
    -- We show ⟦(g, E)⟧ = ⟦(1, n • E)⟧ via (g, E) ~ (1, n • E) and take .symm.
    have hrel : (InductionRel.setoid (G := G) d).r (g, E) ((1 : G), n • E) :=
      ⟨n, hn_G, rfl, hn_P⟩
    exact (Quotient.sound hrel).symm

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.InducedSpace.isQuasiFundDomain_subcomplexOfIota
lean_refs.signature:
instance isQuasiFundDomain_subcomplexOfIota :
    SheafOnBuilding.IsQuasiFundDomain (G := G) d.G' (Subcomplex.ofIota d) where
  G'_le_stab := G'_le_subcomplexOfIota_stabilizer d
  surj q := by
    obtain ⟨g, E, hq_eq⟩ := exists_eq_smul_iota d q
    exact ⟨g, iota d E, ⟨E, rfl⟩, hq_eq.symm⟩
  orbit_iff := by
    rintro q₁ q₂ ⟨E, rfl⟩ ⟨F, rfl⟩ g h h_eq
    rw [smul_iota_eq_smul_iota_iff] at h_eq
    obtain ⟨n, hn_G, hn_smul, hn_P⟩ := h_eq
    refine ⟨n, hn_G, ?_, ?_⟩
    · -- n • iota E = iota F
      rw [iota_smul_of_mem_G' d hn_G, hn_smul]
    · -- (g⁻¹ * h * n) • iota E = iota E
      exact P_le_stabilizer_iota d E hn_P
